VIN.basis: Design: separate protected/switched3S drive input interface; upstream protection not supplied by this integration

GND.basis: Manufacturer: all module ground connections common; design uses common return

VOUT.basis: Design: feed own downstream TPS259813L input, never parallel outputs

ENA.basis: Manufacturer: pulled to VIN by1Mohm, enabled by default. Design leaves open; no MCU connection.

ENB.basis: Manufacturer: pulled to VIN by1Mohm and linked to ENA by10kohm; do not use in defaultPFM. Design leaves open.

PFM.basis: Manufacturer: internal100kohm pullup selectsPFM by default. Design leaves open.

PG.basis: Optional open-drain module output; design leaves unused and distinct from existing eFuse PG signals.

design_decisions: Converters start when protected drive battery input appears; shutdown/rearm is handled downstream by the existing eFuse candidate
Converter operation is not equivalent to permission to energize servo buses
No use of moduleENA/ENB as safety isolation, no addition of MCU high-voltage pin exposure
No claim that modulePFM absorbs regenerative current
Tab5 supply remains independent of these two servo regulators
required_but_unproven: Protected drive battery distribution, fuse/disconnect, inrush and input fault energy
eFuse default-off behavior throughout partial-power startup and every relevant reset/fault
Sequencer monitor qualification and manual rearm timing
Source and output overvoltage protection, current limits, thermal/dropout margin
Regeneration handling, residual energy discharge, reverse-current paths
Physical port/pad mapping, wire gauge, terminals and routing
